Name: Candy Creations
Author: RadicalTubular
Description:
[size=5]General overview:[/size]

This mod adds a candy machine that can be crafted once you hit level 3 farming.
To create candy, place a fruit inside while you have sugar in your inventory.
Each fruit creates its own candy, with buffs based off the color of the fruit, with some exceptions.
Tree fruits create Lollypops, foraged fruits create gummy bears and fruit crops create hard candy.

[size=5]Creation time and value:
[/size]
The candies take 2 in-game hours
The value of the created candy is 1.25x the fruit's value and keeps the quality of the inserted fruit

[size=5]List of buffs and durations:
[/size]
[spoiler]
All candies give +1 speed as well as one other skill.
Foraged fruit and crop fruit buffs last for 300 in-game minutes, and tree fruit buffs last for 480.
All candies listed provide a +1 to speed in addition to the listed skill, unless stated otherwise.

[size=5]Farming (Sweet red fruits):[/size]
Apple
Cherry
Rhubarb
Strawberry

[size=5]Fishing (Blue fruits):[/size]
Ancient fruit (also gives +1 luck and lasts for 780 instead of 300)
Blackberry
Blueberry
Crystal Fruit
Powdermelon
Salmonberry* (exception to color rule)

[size=5]Foraging (Purple fruits and desert forage):[/size]
Cactus fruit
Coconut
Grape
Pomegranate
Wild plum

[size=5]Luck (Pink fruit):[/size]
Melon
Peach

[size=5]Mining (Yellow/Orange fruit):[/size]
Apricot
Banana
Mango
Orange
Pineapple
Starfruit* (Also gives +1 luck and lasts for 600 instead of 300)

[size=5]+2 Speed (Dark red and spicy fruit):[/size]
Cranberries
Hot Pepper
Spice Berry

[size=5]Qi Fruit:[/size]
Only gives +1 speed and only for 120 instead of 300

[/spoiler]
